name: file-upload

native.scope: Native has no browser multipart file carrier. The app adapter owns bytes, upload transport, file policy, validation, and authoritative upload state.

ports.name: file-selection
ports.purpose: An explicit app adapter receives native File selection and cancellation with browser context and a cancellation lifetime. Callback completion is not upload completion.

summary: Presents native file selection alongside explicitly server-owned file states.

agent.useWhen: A form accepts attachments and the application supplies any upload lifecycle or persisted-file state.
agent.avoidWhen: The component would need to transfer bytes, validate server files, or invent an upload transport; the Native host currently admits no multipart file carrier.

contract.role: labelled native file input with server-owned file rows
invariants: Input name/id, labels, accept grammar, descriptions, rows, localized statuses and action URLs are strictly validated and escaped.
At most 25 file rows with unique IDs are rendered; uploading progress is 0..=100.
The declared browser module may show local selection and report native File references to an explicit app adapter; it must never fabricate upload success, persist bytes, fetch, or own transport.
Component completeness is separate from Native multipart carrier support. Authoritative upload rows, validation, progress, and completion remain app-owned.
Serialized fixture/config values contain no raw HTML; action links are safe HTTPS or app-relative paths.
